summary: Amazon launched a free Shop Direct Merchant Workspace so outside stores can plug their products into Alexa for Shopping and Amazon search.
A YouTube creator on Reddit says he was dropped from YouTube Shopping's affiliate program for sharing links outside YouTube, which he says he never did.
ShopMy held its first physical retail event.
Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet; Reddit searches were rate-limited today, so Reddit mentions may be missing.

items.title: Amazon’s new Shop Direct Merchant Workspace makes it even easier for stores across the web to have their products discovered by customers on Alexa for Shopping and Amazon
items.why: Amazon is pulling products from other stores into its own search and Alexa. It wants to be where shopping starts even when the item isn't sold by Amazon.

items.title: When is Cyber Monday 2026? Here’s everything you need to know
items.why: Cyber Monday is 30 November, a peak day for affiliate link clicks.

items.title: Removed from YouTube Shopping affiliate program for "links shared outside YouTube". Has anyone gotten back in?
items.why: A 60K-subscriber creator says he lost YouTube Shopping access for links 'shared outside YouTube'. Platform-owned affiliate programs can cut creators off with little explanation.

items.title: Must Read: PAI Partners Acquires Elemis From L’Occitane, ShopMy Opens First Physical Retail Event
items.why: ShopMy is moving from links into real-world retail events, widening what creator storefronts do.
